Session note: New York ET is the reference timezone. IST must be converted dynamically because the offset changes with US daylight saving time.

ICT models & market context

Models: Silver Bullet, Liquidity sweep + MSS, ICT 2022 Model, Unicorn, SMT, NWOG / NDOG

Drivers: US real yields, Fed repricing, Mega-cap earnings, CPI / NFP / PCE, NQ–ES–YM relative strength

News catalysts: CPI, PPI, NFP, PCE, GDP, FOMC, ISM, JOLTS, NVDA earnings, AAPL earnings, MSFT earnings

Use Weekly/Daily draw on liquidity, PDH/PDL, PWH/PWL and 20/40/60-day extremes. Mark midnight and 09:30 ET opens. Look for a level raid, displacement/MSS and an FVG/OB pullback; target opposing liquidity.

Related markets: ES, YM, RTY, ZN, DX

Comparison discipline: NQ–ES–YM SMT; compare same expiry and synchronised swings.
